In October 2026, we announced positive topline results from GFORCE-1, our completed Phase 1 study of MRT-8102 in subjects with elevated cardiovascular disease risk, and currently expect to initiate GFORCE-2, a Phase 2b study in patients with coronary artery disease, in the first half of 2027, as well as GEMINI-1, a Phase 2 study in patients with gout, in the fourth quarter of 2026 or first quarter of 2027, and GALAXY-1, a Phase 2 study in patients with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa, in the first half of 2027.
